deposit.context: Savings: sheet heading and button for putting money onto an account.

withdraw.context: Savings: sheet heading and button for taking money off an account.

interest.context: Savings: sheet heading and button for recording interest the bank paid.

balance.context: Savings: sheet heading and button for correcting an account's balance to what the bank shows.

allocate.context: Savings: sheet heading and button for setting money on an account aside for a goal.

transfer.context: Savings: sheet heading and button for moving money between two accounts.

noAccount.message: Najpierw dodaj konto: pieniądze muszą gdzieś leżeć.
noAccount.context: Money sheet when there are no accounts.

depositTo.context: Save money sheet: label of the savings account the money goes onto.

depositToHelp.message: Z bieżących pieniędzy. Najpierw liczy się do oszczędności z planu na ten miesiąc; to, co ponad plan, zmniejsza kwotę do wydania.
depositToHelp.context: Save money sheet: under the account field. Income isn't on any account in the app; saving moves money from the everyday pool onto this savings account. What's left to spend already sets aside the plan's savings, so only saving beyond the plan lowers it.

withdrawFrom.context: Take money out sheet: label of the savings account the money comes off.

withdrawFromHelp.message: Wraca do bieżących pieniędzy: kwota do wydania w tym miesiącu wzrośnie o tyle.
withdrawFromHelp.context: Take money out sheet: under the account field. The money goes back to the everyday pool (what's left to spend).

assign.context: Money sheet (assign): option, set aside for the goal.

giveBack.context: Money sheet (assign): option / button, release a goal's money back to unassigned.

for.context: Money sheet (save): which goal the money is for.

takeFrom.context: Money sheet (take out / move): which goal's share the money comes from.

shareHere.context: Money sheet (give back): the goal's share on this account.

available.context: Money sheet: how much can be taken.

noGoal.context: Money sheet (save): option, the money isn't for a goal.

pickGoal.context: Money sheet (assign): empty option of the goal list.

here.context: Money sheet: after a goal in the list, its share on this account.

balanceHelp.message: Aplikacja ma {amount}; różnica zostanie zapisana jako korekta.

balanceHelpGoals.message: Aplikacja ma {amount}; różnica zostanie zapisana jako korekta. Cele mają z tego {goals}.
balanceHelpGoals.context: Money sheet (update balance): hint with the goals' part.

notePlaceholder.context: Money sheet (save): placeholder of the note.
